ops.text: a. Performance Warranties. TrueLink further represents and warrants that (i) the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional manner and in a workmanlike manner; (ii) for a period of ninety (90) days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services and any deliverables will conform to their documentation; (iii) for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery, the Interface and all related software will conform to its documentation; (iv) it will comply with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement; and (v) the Interface and all related software will, at the time provided to Client, be free from viruses, worms, Trojan horses and any other malicious code. Client's remedy for breach of this Section is, at TrueLink's option, repair, replacement, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming services, Interface, software or deliverables.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us only a Y2K warranty, so we add TrueLink's performance warranties: professional and workmanlike Services, a 90-day Services and deliverables conformance period measured from performance, 12-month software conformance to documentation, compliance with laws and no malicious code, with a repair, replacement or refund remedy. This is our preferred warranty position.
